reviewer: verification (not author of this guard increment)
scope: useDraftArchiveGuard and EmptyState eager-open/direct-send ownership, archive admission, first cold catalogue retry, plus referenced store cleanup semantics.

checkpointMatch.note: All 15 source hashes checked; semantic review is limited to the named guard/caller/support paths, not every other frontend change.

findings.topic: A-B-A while catalogue reload remains loading or failed
findings.origin: Independent static trace reported by verification; product author reproduced and repaired.
findings.evidence: aba-direct-red.txt has two failing A-B-A cases plus the repeated direct-send failure.
findings.resolution: A retained canonical archive association is checked with the existing path-component matcher for the current cwd. It preserves a neutral barrier through loading/error without a new multi-directory cache. Unrelated B does not inherit A; a successful empty/recovery-only catalogue releases the association.

findings.topic: direct send late open after archive admission withdrawal
findings.origin: Author and independent read-review converged; author executed the counterexample.
findings.evidence: direct-late-red.txt has one failing discard assertion; the same case repeats in aba-direct-red.txt and is not a second defect.
findings.resolution: The DraftArchiveBlockedError catch retires the returned empty draft; uncertain/content/queued checks remain, and the real store independently refuses to discard nonempty/submitting/running drafts.

findings.topic: first cold catalogue and archive after config await
findings.origin: Root/author counterexamples reviewed from original logs and final source.
findings.evidence: cold-config-red.txt has three failures: first slow list, first failed list, and archive arriving during config await.
findings.resolution: No ready catalogue yields a neutral checking/error gate and explicit read-only retry. Eager open checks after service await, before/after each config await and before adoption. Archive denial is not cached as an unrelated permanent service failure.

ownershipChecks: Retry closure checks mounted, active, exact cwd-owner object, and current loading state; an old A callback cannot regain ownership after A-B-A.
sessions.open shares a pending Promise by draft group. Cancelled eager effects for the same live pair must not destroy the newer effect’s shared result; the new rejectOpened preserves this rule.
A changed cwd/unmounted view or archive barrier rejects a late eager result. Existing hidden prepared-draft behavior remains; a hidden view is not claimed to cancel native execution.

No duplicate native close is inferred merely from a mock discard count: real non-strict discardDraft synchronously forgets the exact thread before awaiting session_close; a later same-key call finds no thread.
The guard cancels only the folderless-send arm, retains draft text/attachments and permission, and does not restore paths, replace cwd, or dispatch a prompt.
Recovery association alone does not establish missing cwd and does not block normal preparation; unrelated paths use component matching rather than raw prefix matching.
New refresh calls the existing single-flight catalogue loader. Its timeout does not end the underlying read; stale ownership prevents late publication.
